TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

    name "Comprehensive 12-week plan: cycle-synced training, nutrition support, aerobic base, HIIT conditioning, plyometrics, phase-2 intensity, power days, and optional 1RM testing"

      DAY Monday training 45m "Strength Start (Flow-informed)":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Hypertrophy Accessory A":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 3 minutes
      DAY Friday training 45m "Upper Push Focus":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3 minutes
      DAY Saturday cardio 18m "HIIT Metabolic Conditioning":
        warmup:
          walking 3 minutes
        main:
          cycling 20 seconds hard / 40 seconds easy x 6 rounds
        cooldown:
          cycling 4 minutes
      DAY Sunday plyometric_power 20m "Plyometric/Power Day Intro":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 3 minutes
          dynamic_leg_swings 1 minute
        main_plyo:
          3x5 clamp_jump x 5
          3x5 tuck_jump x 5
          3x6 standing_broad_jump x 5
        cooldown:
          light jog 4 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Strength Progress A":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility_flow 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Hypertrophy Accessory B":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          glute_stretch 3 minutes
      DAY Friday training 45m "Upper Push + Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds

          chest_stretch 3 minutes
      DAY Saturday cardio 20m "HIIT Short Intervals":

          4x6 squat_jump
          4x6 clip_jump

        cooldown:
          mobility_flow 5 minutes
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Strength Progress B":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x5 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 5x5 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hips_thighs_release 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Hypertrophy Block A":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:

        main straight_sets:

          walking 3 minutes
        main:

        cooldown:

      DAY Sunday plyometric_power 24m "Power Day Progression":

          jog_in_place 3 minutes
          leg_dynamic_mm 1 minute

    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Deload Week 1":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility_routine 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Hypertrophy Block B":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:

          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds

          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3 minutes

      DAY Monday training 60m "Phase 2 Intensified Strength & Power Start":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:

          bench_press 5x5 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 5x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        plyometrics:
          3x5 squat_jump
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3 minutes
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Hypertrophy Block C":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          glute_stretch 3 minutes
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Push + Pull Emphasis + Power Spark":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 5x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 4x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 4x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        plyometrics:
          3x5 clap_push_sequence
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3 minutes
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Aerobic Base + Strength Blend":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          cycling 15 minutes steady state
        plyometrics:
          3x5 tuck_jump_depth
        cooldown:
          mobility_flow 5 minutes
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Hypertrophy Block D":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 3 minutes

          leg_extension 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds

    WEEK 6:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Push/Pull Blend + Power":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          overhead_press 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_fly 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        plyometrics:
          3x5 split_squat_jump
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3 minutes
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Deload Phase 2":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility_routine 5 minutes
      WEEK 7:
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Hypertrophy Block E":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 3 minutes
      WEEK 7:
      DAY Friday training 50m "Upper Push + Pull Mix":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3 minutes
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Flow-friendly Week 8 (Flow window aligned)":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          pendlay_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility_flow 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Hypertrophy Focus":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_stretch 3 minutes
      DAY Friday training 50m "Aerobic Endurance Mix":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main:
          cycling 2x12 minutes at moderate pace with 2 minutes easy between
        cooldown:
          cycling 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3 Test & Taper" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday testing 60m "1RM Testing Window - Lower/Total":
        notes:

          - bench_press 1RM_attempts: same protocol
          - barbell_row 1RM_attempts: same protocol
        fallback:
          if 1RM testing not performed: use rep-max testing (e.g., 3x1RM or 5x3) or velocity-based estimate within acceptable safety margin
        cooldown:
          mobility_routine 5 minutes

        cooldown:

      DAY Friday training 45m "Flow-friendly & Recovery":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main:

        main straight_sets:

          barbell_row 3x5 rpe 9 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:

    WEEK 10:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Hypertrophy Maintenance & Technique":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_stretch 3 minutes
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Taper Start & Polish":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3 minutes
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Taper & Flow Optimization":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 2x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 2x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility_routine 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Active Recovery & Mobility":
        warmup:
          light walk 5 minutes
        main:
          mobility flow, slow tempo revisits
        cooldown:
          full-body stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 40m "1RM Testing Conclusion (if performed) or Retest Window":
        notes:
          - If 1RM was performed: use remaining sessions to consolidate loads around tested numbers with 2–3 sets per lift at ~85% of new 1RM
          - If 1RM not performed: continue with safe volume and technique focus
        cooldown:
          mobility_routine 5 minutes
  END PHASES

NUTRITION PLAN
  NOTES
    - This plan supports cycle-related fatigue and cramps, emphasizing hydration, electrolyte balance, iron and magnesium intake, and appropriate carbohydrate timing.
    - On flow days (days with heavy cramps), adjust to lower intensity guidance in training and focus on recovery nutrition; hydration remains prioritized.
  WEEKLY GUIDANCE
    - Calorie target: maintain current weight. Adjust by ±250 kcal if weight trend deviates (increase if energy low, decrease if unwanted gain).
    - Protein: 1.6–2.2 g per kg bodyweight per day.
    - Carbohydrates: 4–7 g per kg bodyweight on training days, taper to 3–5 g/kg on lighter days.
    - Fats: balance remaining calories, focusing on unsaturated fats.
    - Iron: aim 8–18 mg/day; include heme sources (red meat, poultry, fish) or fortified plant sources; consider iron supplement if deficiency suspected (consult clinician).
    - Magnesium: 300–420 mg/day from foods and/or supplements as advised; supports cramping reduction.
    - Calcium: 1000–1200 mg/day; include dairy or fortified alternatives.
  DAILY STRUCTURE
    - Pre-workout meal 1.5–2 hours before training: 1 serving carb source, moderate protein, low fat.
    - Intra-workout (if long session): 30–60 g carbohydrate per hour (e.g., sports drink, jelly beans, or energy chews).
    - Post-workout: protein 20–40 g within 1 hour; add 1–2 servings of carbohydrate to replenish glycogen.
    - Rich in fruits and vegetables for micronutrients and hydration.
  FLOW-DROWNING ACCOMMODATIONS (on days 1–3 of flow)
    - Training: reduce volume by 20–40% and avoid high-impact or heavy Valsalva. Prioritize technique over loading.
    - Nutrition: increase magnesium intake via meals; ensure adequate fluids and electrolyte-containing beverages (sodium, potassium).
  WEEKLY NUTRITION ROUTINES
    - Hydration: aim 30–40 ml/kg/day water; add electrolyte beverages during heavy training days or heat.
    - Electrolytes: include sodium 1,500–2,300 mg/day, potassium 2,500–3,500 mg/day depending on intake and sweat loss.
    - Iron-rich meals: include at least 2 iron-containing meals per day (heme iron preferred) and pair non-heme iron with vitamin C sources to improve absorption.
    - Anti-cramp foods: consider banana, yogurt, leafy greens, beans, seeds, and whole grains daily.
  SAMPLE DAY
    - Breakfast: oats with milk, berry mix, and a handful of nuts; spinach omelet; orange juice.
    - Lunch: quinoa bowl with chicken, broccoli, cherry tomatoes, olive oil.
    - Snack: yogurt with fruit; or hummus with whole-grain crackers.
    - Dinner: salmon, sweet potato, greens salad; avocado.
    - Evening: small casein protein if training late; water or electrolyte beverage.
  NOTES
    - If fatigue persists or iron status concerns arise, consult a clinician for labs and tailored supplementation.
    - This nutrition plan should be adapted to individual preferences, tolerances, and cultural considerations.

CARDIO PATTERN
  - Phase 1 includes Zone 2 cardio days and HIIT days; Phase 2 expands aerobic base with occasional steady-state cycles and aerobic intervals; Phase 3 taper preserves conditioning while prioritizing performance.

  NOTES
    - This plan supports cycle-related fatigue and cramps, emphasizing hydration, electrolyte balance, iron and magnesium intake, and appropriate carbohydrate timing.

    - Calorie target: maintain current weight. Adjust by ±250 kcal if weight trend deviates (increase if energy low, decrease if unwanted gain).

    - Dinner: salmon, sweet potato, greens salad; avocado.
    - Evening: small casein protein if training late; water or electrolyte beverage.
  NOTES
    - If fatigue persists or iron status concerns arise, consult a clinician for labs and tailored supplementation.
    - This nutrition plan should be adapted to individual preferences, tolerances, and cultural considerations.

  NOTES
    - This plan supports cycle-related fatigue and cramps, emphasizing hydration, electrolyte balance, iron and magnesium intake, and appropriate carbohydrate timing.

  WEEKLY GUIDANCE
    - Calorie target: maintain current weight. Adjust by ±250 kcal if weight trend deviates (increase if energy low, decrease if unwanted gain).
    - Protein: 1.6–2.2 g per kg bodyweight per day.
    - Carbohydrates: 4–7 g per kg bodyweight on training days, taper to 3–5 g/kg on lighter days.
    - Fats: balance remaining calories, focusing on unsaturated fats.
    - Iron: aim 8–18 mg/day; include heme sources (red meat, poultry, fish) or fortified plant sources; consider iron supplement if deficiency suspected (consult clinician).
    - Magnesium: 300–420 mg/day from foods and/or supplements as advised; supports cramping reduction.
    - Calcium: 1000–1200 mg/day; include dairy or fortified alternatives.
  DAILY STRUCTURE
    - Pre-workout meal 1.5–2 hours before training: 1 serving carb source, moderate protein, low fat.
    - Intra-workout (if long session): 30–60 g carbohydrate per hour (e.g., sports drink, jelly beans, or energy chews).

    - Training: reduce volume by 20–40% and avoid high-impact or heavy Valsalva. Prioritize technique over loading.

    - Hydration: aim 30–40 ml/kg/day water; add electrolyte beverages during heavy training days or heat.
    - Electrolytes: include sodium 1,500–2,300 mg/day, potassium 2,500–3,500 mg/day depending on intake and sweat loss.
    - Iron-rich meals: include at least 2 iron-containing meals per day (heme iron preferred) and pair non-heme iron with vitamin C sources to improve absorption.
    - Anti-cramp foods: consider banana, yogurt, leafy greens, beans, seeds, and whole grains daily.
